notes: «جميعا عن فضيل بن غزوان» joins the first two routes; the name is written in each of them because the third route (Abu Kurayb) does not meet them.
«أبو كريب، محمد بن العلاء» is one man (kunya, comma, name, rule 7). «- واللفظ له -» is a gloss.
«عن أبيه» : Ibn Fudayl's father, a relation. «وفي حديث» wording differences are not routes.
